prompt: A desktop landing page for AMZYA Contracting LLC, a contracting company in Dubai, rendered edge to edge with crisp readable text and no browser window, device or desk around it. The website is under construction; the visitor wants to confirm the company is real and contact it. What leads: the entire page is the printed hoarding fence that surrounds a Dubai construction site, seen flat and straight on, made of tall adjoining panels with thin steel posts between them and a strip of real ground and sky-free plain wall at the edges. The panels alternate solid burgundy, white, and a burgundy field of fine diagonal hairlines. Huge lettering runs across several panels, breaking over the joints: Our website is under construction. A second run in Arabic: موقعنا الإلكتروني قيد الإنشاء. Set into the middle of the fence is a real site door, opened slightly, carrying a plain white contact plate with three clearly clickable buttons stacked: WhatsApp, Email, Company profile. One panel lists the five services in small type: Building construction, Civil engineering & infrastructure, MEP & specialized technical services, Fit-out & renovation, Maintenance. Frame: the AMZYA logo from the second reference printed on the first panel at top left, an EN / عربي toggle at top right, no other navigation; along the foot of the fence, AMZYA Contracting LLC, Dubai, UAE. The first reference carries the real brand: colours, Jost type, sharp corners; its layout and content must not be copied.
